sentences.text:
Bench: D.Ramesh
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.3533 of 2020
Order:

This petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 by the petitioners,
who is accused Nos.1 and 2 in Crime No.405 of 2020 on the file of Lalapet Police Station, Guntur District.

The offences alleged are under sections 188, 269, 272 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860, and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, and consequently release TVS XL Moped No.AP 07 DP 4018.
2.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent.
3. Both the counsel submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order dated 27.08.2018, passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731of 2018 and batch.

4. In view of the above and in terms of the afore said order, this Criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No.405 of 2020 on the file of Lalapet Police Station,
Guntur District are hereby quashed; consequently, TVS XL Moped bearing No.AP 07 DP 4018 shall be returned to the petitioners on proof of ownership.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.
5. The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Criminal Petition No.3731of 2018, dated 27.08.2018 to this order.

JUSTICE D.RAMESH Date: 01.9.2020 YS Obulasetty Hari Babu Al vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh., on 1 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39307258/
